segments.name: Futures and securities brokerage services
segments.description: Commission-earning trading of futures and securities for customers across global markets.
segments.evidence: The Group's futures and securities brokerage segment generates commission income by enabling customers to trade in futures and securities markets throughout the world.

segments.name: Market making (CFD) trading
segments.description: Acts as counterparty to customers in CFD derivative transactions, earning trading gains and losses.
segments.evidence: The Group engages in market making (CFD trading) activities where it serves as the counterparty to its customers in derivative transactions.

segments.name: TRS trading
segments.description: Earns commissions and interest from total return swap trading for customers.
segments.evidence: The Group generated income from TRS trading business including the commission income from the securities trading and interest income from the loan to customers.

segments.name: OTC stock option trading
segments.description: Trading gains and losses from OTC stock option contracts where the group is the counterparty.
segments.evidence: The Group also generated trading gains or losses from the OTC stock options where it serves as the counterparty in the option contracts.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Residual businesses: insurance brokerage, proprietary trading, NFT platform and Metaverse games, and corporate overhead.
segments.evidence: Other businesses include the following: (1) insurance brokerage segment which generates commissions by providing insurance brokerage services to high-net-worth individuals; (2) proprietary trading activities in investment securities, futures and derivatives, (3) sale of NFT and development NFT platform and Metaverse games, and (4) executive management functions and corporate overhead.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay commission income for futures and securities trades, and the company earns trading gains and interest on CFD, TRS and OTC option business.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group's futures and securities brokerage segment generates commission income by enabling customers to trade in futures and securities markets throughout the world.

changes.text: In 2024 the group disposed of its insurance brokerage services.
changes.evidence: In June 2024, the Group disposed of its insurance brokerage services.

changes.text: In 2025 the group exited futures and securities brokerage services in Hong Kong markets.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the Group exited from its futures and securities brokerage services in Hong Kong markets.
